caption:
Talking to a camera is not easy.

It takes reps. I've done this for over 10 years and I still get clients who tell me, "I saw one of your videos."

Emails, text blasts, mail and referrals all work. Social media gets you the most reach for the least money.

I got a video to 3 million views reviewing AirPods with nothing behind it. Imagine that with a business behind it.

DM me AUDIT and I'll tell you what your business should be filming.
